thread:
Nadia_CS: Quick flag — MeridianPay (Enterprise) embed and search-route volume down ~46% over the last 9 days. Renewal in ~5w. Procurement has asked for a head-to-head vs AltServe and their champion moved to a different team last sprint. Seat activity and batch embed jobs most impacted. Need triage + retention options. @Eli_CSM @Hugo_SE can we coordinate outreach?

Eli_CSM: Ack. Paste the dashboard link + top-line deltas and any billing freeze indicators. want 7d vs 30d comparisons.

Nadia_CS: Dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/meridianpay/overview — embeds -46% 7d, gen -12%, nightly batch jobs failing to keep up. No 5xx spike; occasional 429s at peak windows. Billing shows no holds but procurement opened a vendor evaluation thread.

Hugo_SE: Any recent model variant flips or client SDK changes? Embeds and batched jobs often break when a new variant changes tokenization or cache keys.

Nadia_CS: Timeline shows model routing nudged to `meridian-embed-q` at 50% on 2026-10-04 and a client SDK micro-patch on 10-05 that adjusted default prefix handling.

Hugo_SE: Likely interplay of quantization + prefix change. I'll pull KV cache hit rates, batch latency percentiles, and tokenization diffs. Also propose we offer a "canary holdback": keep 30% traffic on the prior variant for 72h to measure delta in real traffic before any full rollback.

Rosa_RevOps: On credits/pilot — we can approve a 21-day reserved burst for their critical embed batch route up to $12k or a one-time invoice credit. Legal will need to approve terms for the burst. Need acct id + last invoice to queue.

Ian_Product: I'll prepare a short "cost-to-switch" analysis: estimate their engineering effort + integration risk if they move to AltServe vs incremental fixes with us. We can also run a reproducible smoke harness using a small sample of their dataset to compare embeddings quality/latency vs AltServe. That might be more persuasive than list-price comps.

Eli_CSM: Love the harness idea. Can we also offer a white-glove 2-week remediation SOW (our SE + their engs) to stabilize their batch jobs and tune caching? Tie it to a conditional credit if KPIs not met.

Hugo_SE: On-call plan for the readout: I'll bring a rollback runbook, KV hit heatmaps, and an A/B traffic plan. Quick self-check we can give them: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/debug/prefix_cache?account=MERIDIANPAY` — returns recent prefix-key hit rates.

alert-bot: usage-alert: account=MERIDIANPAY embeds delta=-46% (7d); gen delta=-12% (7d); flagged renewal-risk.

Rosa_RevOps: Sent last invoice INV-13077 to Nadia. Legal looped for SOW + promo terms.

Eli_CSM: Draft outreach — please edit: "Hi team — we've noticed a significant drop in embed volume and understand procurement is evaluating other vendors. We'd like 25 minutes to share a reproducible readout (including a smoke harness we can run on your sample data), propose a short remediation SOW + a 21-day reserved burst, and walk through a canary holdback A/B plan so you can see concrete delta. Available Tue/Thu next week? — Eli"

Ian_Product: I'll prepare the harness notebook and cost-to-switch slide. ETA EOD.

Hugo_SE: I'll prepare the heatmaps and expected recovery curves if we holdback or rollback. If cache-key mismatch is the root cause, rollback or prefix tuning usually recovers embed volume within 24 hours.

Nadia_CS: Plan sounds good. I'll schedule Tue 11am PT readout with procurement + eng + new PM and send the outreach after final edits. Marking renewal-risk and high priority.
